close_reason: stoa-5yi4k.8: Removed dead !peer.tls check from run_smtp_session (do_deliver pre-connect guard already handles it); EHLO REQUIRETLS advertisement check retained. stoa-5yi4k.9: Added SAFETY comments at both std::sync::Mutex lock sites explaining guard is not held across await points. All 291 tests pass.
description: relay_client.rs do_deliver (line ~299) checks if envelope.require_tls && !peer.tls and returns Permanent before TCP connect. run_smtp_session also checks the same condition (line ~482) after EHLO. The second check is unreachable because do_deliver already filtered it. Remove the redundant check from run_smtp_session, or extract a single check into a shared guard function. As-is, a reader must understand two separate places that claim to enforce the same rule.
title: Duplicate REQUIRETLS pre-connect guard in run_smtp_session is dead code
